body:
Hey guys! 
I'll thought I would share my Second montage.
Its not the best thing ever created and isn't the best quality. To tell you the truth I could've added some minor changes but my computer was dying so I gave up in the end.
Hopefully I didn't downgrade it too much, feel free to share it around and enjoy the video.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VSF9hAxk3rg
Programs used: FCPX, Ocam, Motion
Music: Unexpected by David Bulla
